title: An uppercase remote scheme hides the repository from github_repo
what: github_repo matches the remote URL scheme with an exact lowercase match, so a remote written HTTPS://github.com/o/r (or SSH://git@github.com/o/r), which git itself accepts, returns None. The pull request poll then drops that workspace with no error, gh_repo_arg passes no --repo, and scm_repo_id::identity loses the legacy owner/name key.
expected: A URL scheme is case-insensitive (RFC 3986), so github_repo must match it without regard to case and return the same GhRepo for the uppercase form as for the lowercase one.
